type: Current Winery Pyramid payout and calibration specification

calibration.method: Previously published 250,000-game anchor means corrected with paired 32,000-game differences for the modified count prizes; upper anchors use paired 70,000-game estimates
calibration.note: RTP values are estimated expectations, not guarantees; the previous payout validation cannot be applied directly to the new table
calibration.sugar_tail_probability_columns: Full cups >=11, >=12, >=13, >=14; original calibration retained for existing scales because payouts do not alter physical fills

historical_validation_legacy_not_current.note: Previous v1 Monte Carlo study used a different payout table and must not be cited as current v72 game RTP
